mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO AS "memberNo", NICKNAME AS "nickname", PROFILE_IMAGE AS "profileImage", EMAIL AS "email" FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'A' AND MEMBER_NO != #{memberNo} AND (NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') ORDER BY NICKNAME FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CHATTING_ROOM_NO FROM CHATTING_ROOM WHERE (OPEN_MEMBER = #{memberNo} AND PARTICIPANT = #{targetNo}) OR (OPEN_MEMBER = #{targetNo} AND PARTICIPANT = #{memberNo}) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATTING_ROOM (CHATTING_ROOM_NO, OPEN_MEMBER, PARTICIPANT) VALUES (SEQ_CHATTING_ROOM_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{targetNo})
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_NO, MESSAGE_CONTENT, READ_FL, SENDER_NO, CHATTING_ROOM_NO, TO_CHAR(SEND_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SEND_TIME FROM MESSAGE WHERE CHATTING_ROOM_NO = #{chattingRoomNo} ORDER BY MESSAGE_NO ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MESSAGE (MESSAGE_NO, MESSAGE_CONTENT, SENDER_NO, CHATTING_ROOM_NO) VALUES (SEQ_MESSAGE_NO.NEXTVAL, #{messageContent}, #{senderNo}, #{chattingRoomNo})
